about_the_game:
Note: This visual novel follows a linear storyline with no branching paths. The character artwork is created using Koikatu-based rotoscoping. Thank you for your interest!

Story Introduction:
To fend off the invasion of the demon clan, ten young maidens gather to initiate the "Sunrise Protection Array." However, four of them are not human but rather demonic beings brainwashed by the demons. Their task is to identify the hidden demons among them and successfully complete the initiation ceremony. Through team formation, voting, and the use of special abilities... Can these maidens successfully carry out the ritual by piecing together various clues?

Highlights:

  • Substantial script (5 chapters, approximately 400,000 Chinese characters)

  • The core creator has experience with Avalon and Werewolf—suitable for both newcomers and seasoned players

  • A demo version (Chapters 1-2, 150,000 characters) is planned for release in October 2025—welcome to try it out!

Additional Notes:
The "ritual" performed by the maidens in this work is based on the rules of the board game Avalon, with certain modifications made to suit the narrative. Specifically, adjustments have been made to the victory conditions, the "Lady of the Lake" role, and forced rounds. As a result, the rules of the "ritual" in this work are heavily skewed in favor of the human side, disrupting the balance of the original Avalon game. We appreciate our readers' understanding and apologize for any inconvenience this may cause!

short_description: "Four of Ten" is a multi-perspective visual novel blending time regression with Avalon-style gameplay. Set in a world where demonic forces invade human territories, ten young maidens gather at an ancient magical site to conduct a five-round ritual aimed at activating a protective barrier.
